case_number: 2024 INSC 445; Special Leave Petition (C) No. 4049 of 2020 (with related I.A. Nos. 120227/2020, 120235/2020, 120248/2020)
summary: Landlord-tenant dispute involving four tenancies; key issue: applicability of West Bengal Tenancy Act, 1997 vs Transfer of Property Act, 1882; lease executed in 1992 (pre-tenancy act); trial court held T.P. Act governs; High Court reversed in favor of tenancy act; Supreme Court focused on pending interlocutory applications seeking market-rate rent payments during litigation; property located in commercial Dalhousie area of Kolkata; tenant allegedly defaulted on rent since 2002; landlord sought occupational charges at Rs.41/sq.ft; tenant contested claiming landlord-tenant relationship still valid; rent determination pending final disposition of main suit; interim relief granted for market rent during pendency of appeals.
final_judgment: Interlocutory applications disposed of; direction issued to tenant to pay market-rate occupational charges during pendency of appeals; specific rate to be determined based on independent valuation.
